name: monstera-feature
description: Implement one task from a Kiro Spec: plan, implement, independent review loop, quality gates.

steps.prompt: Delete .kiro/workflow-output/feature/ if it exists. Read .kiro/steering/*.md and the Kiro Spec .kiro/specs/{{kiro_spec}}/ (requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md). Task: {{task}}. Write an ordered plan to .kiro/workflow-output/feature/plan.md: files to change, tests to add, and the requirement IDs each change satisfies. The Kiro Spec is not monstera.spec.json; do not confuse them. Do not edit source files.

Implement the plan in {{artifacts.plan}}. If .kiro/workflow-output/feature/review.md exists, first fix every blocking finding in it. Never edit generator-owned output by hand: change the spec or templates and run the generator. Run the unit tests. Commit with a message citing the requirement IDs.

Review the commits made for {{artifacts.plan}} against .kiro/specs/{{kiro_spec}}/requirements.md and .kiro/steering/*.md. Write findings to .kiro/workflow-output/feature/review.md. Write {"verdict":"APPROVED"} or {"verdict":"CHANGES_REQUESTED"} to .kiro/workflow-output/feature/verdict.json.

Run `tools/monstera/bin/monstera gates` (Windows: `py -3 tools/monstera/monstera.py gates`) and save its full output to .kiro/workflow-output/feature/gates.txt. Mark the task complete in .kiro/specs/{{kiro_spec}}/tasks.md only if every gate passed; otherwise report the failing gates and leave it open.
